entities.name: UAC-0041
entities.gloss: A threat actor tracked by CERT-UA known for conducting mass phishing campaigns distributing stealers.

entities.name: RelicRace
entities.gloss: A .NET downloader malware designed to download, decode, and execute the RelicSource payload in memory.

entities.name: RelicSource
entities.gloss: A .NET installer and dropper malware that decrypts resources and launches secondary payloads.

entities.name: OneDrive
entities.gloss: A cloud-based file storage and synchronization service developed by Microsoft.

entities.name: Telegram
entities.gloss: A cloud-based instant messaging service and application platform.

entities.name: Formbook
entities.gloss: An information stealer malware that logs keystrokes, harvests credentials, and exfiltrates sensitive data.

entities.name: Snake Keylogger
entities.gloss: An infostealer and keylogger malware designed to record keystrokes and steal sensitive credentials.

entities.name: Остаточний платіж.tgz
entities.gloss: A compressed TGZ archive distributed as an attachment in malicious phishing emails.

entities.name: Остаточний платіж.tar
entities.gloss: A tar archive file extracted from the malicious email attachment.

entities.name: Остаточний платіж.exe
entities.gloss: An executable file delivering the RelicRace malware.

entities.name: Mvbsbaoqmoffjfvhqvkpaia.dll
entities.gloss: A dynamic link library file associated with the RelicSource malware component.

entities.name: formbook.exe
entities.gloss: An executable payload file delivering Formbook malware.

entities.name: clientes@taximadridclass.com
entities.gloss: An email address observed as an indicator of compromise in the phishing campaign.

entities.name: info@kivanclardokum.com.tr
entities.gloss: An email address observed as an indicator of compromise in the phishing campaign.

entities.name: barbacoalosmartinez.com
entities.gloss: An internet domain identified as network infrastructure in the cyber incident.

relations.head: UAC-0041
relations.evidence: Активність має систематичний, масовий та географічно розосереджений характер і відстежується за ідентифікатором UAC-0041.

relations.head: RelicRace
relations.evidence: RelicRace, призначений для завантаження (здебільшого з OneDrive), декодування та запуску в пам'яті шкідливої .NET-програми RelicSource

relations.head: RelicRace
relations.evidence: RelicRace, призначений для завантаження (здебільшого з OneDrive)

relations.head: RelicSource
relations.evidence: Як пейлоад використовуються програми-стілери, а саме: Formbook

relations.head: RelicSource
relations.evidence: Як пейлоад використовуються програми-стілери, а саме: Formbook та Snake Keylogger

relations.head: Snake Keylogger
relations.evidence: Snake Keylogger (ексфільтрація за допомогою API Telegram)

relations.head: Остаточний платіж.tgz
relations.evidence: Архів містить EXE-файл, що класифіковано як .NET-даунлоадер RelicRace

newRelationTypes.name: operates

newRelationTypes.name: downloads-from
newRelationTypes.definition: The malware or actor downloads data or payloads from the specified hosting service or server.

newRelationTypes.name: deploys
newRelationTypes.definition: The subject malware installs, launches, or executes the target payload on a compromised host.

newRelationTypes.name: exfiltrates-to
newRelationTypes.definition: The malware transmits stolen information or telemetry data to the specified service or platform.

newRelationTypes.name: contains-file
